StructElement.description:
A list of structure InputObject.
Each element of inputObjects has:
    • svSearchForBOMLine – Input BOMLine for which the Solution Variants need to be searched depending on VariantRule. Child Item Revision will be retrieved from this BOMLine and the Solution Variant related to this Child Item Revision will be retrieved.
    • variantRuleSourceBOMLine - Input BOMLine from which VariantRule Objects will be searched. VariantRule Objects will be retrieved from this BOMLine object’s Child Item Revision, or the Configurator Context attached to the Child Item.
    • inputVariantRules - A list of VariantRule Objects as input. This parameter is optional to variantRuleSourceBOMLine. Need to pass svSearchForBOMLine as well with this input.

When VariantRule Objects are provided as input, this operation will not search for VariantRule Objects. Instead, this will use these input VariantRule Objects for retrieving the Solution Variants for input svSearchForBOMLine. Same VariantRule Objects along with input BOMLine Objects and the retrieved Solution Variants will be returned in the output.

StructElement.description:
A list of SVFilterInfo. Each element from the list is Used for specifying filter types to apply filters like ‘presence of the Solution Variant’, ‘valid and complete’, ‘Release Status Name’ and ‘GRM Relation Type’ while getting the VariantRule. Below are more details about these filter criteria. Filtering will be done depending on these filter criteria.

hasSolutionVariant - Indicate to check whether Generic ItemRevision has a corresponding Solution Variant. Valid values (case sensitive) are:
•    True - Only return VariantRule Objects having associated SolutionVariants.
•    False - Only return VariantRule Objects not having associated SolutionVariants.
•    Empty – Pass empty string for this input. This will return all VariantRule Objects irrespective of having associated SolutionVariants.
vrValidAndCompleteCheck - Indication to check whether VariantRule Objects being returned are valid and complete. Valid values (case sensitive) are:
•    True - Only return Valid and Complete VariantRule Objects.
•    False - Only VariantRule Objects which are not Valid and Complete.
•    Empty - Pass empty string for this input. Return all VariantRule Objects. Doesn’t check for Valid and Completeness of VariantRule Objects.
svSourceCategory – Solution Variant Category. On applying this filter, Solution Variants of only this input category will be returned. If no input given with this filter, all the Solution Variants irrespective of their category will be returned.
Valid values are: ‘Managed’, ‘Unmanaged’ and ‘Reuse’.
releaseStatusNameOnVR - Name of the release status applied on the Solution Variant. On applying this filter, only Solution Variants having this Release Status will be returned. If no value provided for this filter, filtering depending on Release Status on the Solution Variant will not be done and all the searched Solution Variants, irrespective of their release status, will be returned.
grmRelationTypeName - Name of the GRM Relation type between Generic Item Revision and the Solution Variant. On applying this filter, only Solution Variants having this GRM relation type will be returned. If no value provided for this filter, filtering depending on GRM Relation type will not be done and all the searched Solution Variants, irrespective of their GRM Relation, will be returned.

ParameterInfo.description: A Cfg0ConfiguratorPerspective is a runtime business object representing a snapshot of a Configurator Product Context object. The ownership of the runtime object is with the calling application and ultimately with the client since all the server layers are stateless.

The configuration solve profile as JSON string that consists of attributes governing the behavior of configurator constraint evaluation. This string should adhere to the JSON schema for solve profile defined in SolveProfile_Schema.json; please refer to schema and sample solve profiles defined at %TC_DATA%/json/variabilityadaptor/schema for details. Each solve profile key should occur only once in the solve profile JSON string.

A limiting expression which is used to compute a buildable combination. For Build combinations consumption in BOM, the limiting expression will be empty by default and it is an optional parameter. This parameter is added for future scope.

A list of objects identifying the variability scope to be considered while generating the buildable combinations. Valid types are: Cfg0AbsFamily families from the same product context to generate the build combinations. This list should not contain a free form family. The supported subtypes are: Cfg0AbsFamily and Cfg0AbsFeature, Cfg0AbsFeatureFamily, Cfg0AbsModelFamily and Cfg0AbsOptionFamily. This is an optional parameter.
A list of context elements or organisational nodes having the scope variability information.The supported types are Ptn0Partition, ItemRevision and their subtypes.

A map (BOMLine, list of String) of BOMLine to the list of Build Combination expressions to set on that BOMLine.
When the intent is “generate”, this map should contain list of BOMLine objects and an empty list of variant expressions against each BOMLine object.
When the intent is “update”, this map should contain the list of BOMLine objects and the corresponding list of variant expressions to set against each BOMLine object.

Intent of operation. Supported values are
1. “generate” : To generate the Build Combinations for the input context elements.
